dict.string: Krishi-Saarthi requires camera access to scan crop leaves for real-time disease diagnosis, spot dosage analysis, and fertilizer QR authenticity verification.
Krishi-Saarthi allows selecting leaf photos for AI crop disease analysis.
Krishi-Saarthi requires microphone access for voice-based agricultural queries and voice copilot in Hindi and regional Indian languages.
Krishi-Saarthi uses speech recognition to convert voice commands into agricultural queries for offline farmer advisory.
Krishi-Saarthi uses your location to fetch hyper-local weather alerts, nearest APMC mandi commodity prices, and geospatial disease risk maps.
Krishi-Saarthi uses location for real-time crop disease hotspot telemetry and localized emergency weather broadcasts.
Krishi-Saarthi uses Bluetooth Low Energy to form peer-to-peer offline mesh networks between neighboring farmers to sync telemetry without internet.
Krishi-Saarthi broadcasts and syncs offline disease telemetry across rural mesh nodes.
